cause_of_death: Blunt force trauma with internal hemorrhage
report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Vikram Singh | Age: 63
Body Temperature at Scene: 25.3°C | Ambient Temperature: 31.6°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 9.3 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  2. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  3. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
